scripts.prompt:generate: bun -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const {openuiChatPromptOptions}=require("@openuidev/react-ui"); const {myLibrary}=require("./openui-frontend/src/lib/my-library.tsx"); const prompt=myLibrary.prompt({...openuiChatPromptOptions, componentGroups: {...openuiChatPromptOptions.componentGroups, "Custom Cards": [myLibrary.components.WeatherCard, myLibrary.components.StockCard, myLibrary.components.TaskCard, myLibrary.components.DocPreviewCard]}, additionalRules: [...(openuiChatPromptOptions.additionalRules || []), "When the user asks for weather, call the Weather tool and render the result using WeatherCard.", "When the user asks for stock quotes, call StockQuoteTool and render using StockCard.", "When the user asks to manage or view tasks, call TaskManagerTool and render each task as a TaskCard placed DIRECTLY in the root Card children list (e.g. root = Card([header, t1, t2, t3])); never wrap TaskCard, WeatherCard, StockCard or DocPreviewCard inside VisualCardBlock, CompositeCardBlock or any other *Block, and never put the answer in a markdown code fence.", "When the user asks about documentation, specs, pricing, or product features, call SearchDocsTool to retrieve accurate information and render using DocPreviewCard.", "When the user asks about recent events, live web facts, or news, call WebSearchTool. To extract full content from a specific URL, call WebScrapeTool.", "When showing code, use CodeBlock(language, codeString) with an ordinary double-quoted string: write line breaks as \\n and escape any inner double quote as \\\" (or use single quotes inside the code). NEVER use backticks, template literals or ${...} interpolation anywhere in the response. Keep each code sample under 10 lines, define every variable you reference (a name listed in a children array without its own line is an error), and define each variable name exactly once (reusing a name overwrites the earlier definition and drops its content)."]}); fs.writeFileSync("config/system_prompt_openui.txt", prompt); console.log("Generated config/system_prompt_openui.txt with all tools");'
